title: Scenario 3 (Translation Project v25.1, experimental)

module_containers.evidence: Verified v25.1 X014 loader 060896BC gets an effect index from 06098F28, multiplies it by 0x8000, and calls BOOT 060124DC with file ID 0xBF (EFFECT.BIN), destination 06048D00, source byte offset index*0x8000 and length 0x8000. The update path calls 06048D00 at 0608B114. Disc container is exactly 69 chunks; all three header veneers in each chunk point inside the loaded chunk. Static loader mapping; individual effects still require gameplay validation.

modules.stack_return_evidence: Three drawing-command wrappers save the caller PR immediately before calling the shared queue guard. Its full-queue branch deliberately pops that saved PR and returns past the wrapper; accept only the exact one-word stack pop to the saved caller address. Other unexpected returns remain checked. The three equivalent helper bodies and all direct callers were verified in each registered revision.
